clips.name: Tries to cry like the grown-ups
Gets their tentacles in a tangle
Counts the tears in the vial
Bows with a hand on the heart
Pushes it back with a sly smile
Dips on the air in greeting
Hand to heart and turns away
Shapes a ghast in the air
Listens and toys with the vial cord
Holds a vial to the light
Lets a tear fall on a wound
Taps the ash from the broom
